text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 Primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Frozen models, each trained on one year. Each dot is one substation's mean difference. Above zero: the old year is worse.'

Each dot is one substation's mean difference. Above zero: the old year is worse.
